fields.description: Leading byte of EEPROM address-0 block; sole nonzero byte (0x01) in the fresh live-captured save, consistent with a save-init/exists marker.
fields.evidence: FUN_080427b8 reads EEPROM address 0 as one 8-byte block (4x u16) from bus 0x0D000000; FUN_080429dc verifies that block word-wise against a 4-word RAM buffer; FUN_0804287c/FUN_08042868 is the matching 8-byte write path. Rev8-logical baseline byte 0 = 0x01, the only nonzero byte in samples/baseline.sav.

fields.description: Second u16 word of EEPROM address-0 block (rev8-logical bytes 2..3); zero in the fresh save.
